question: Name the app released by the Indian Army for an in-house messaging application for the military sector.
solution:
The correct answer is __**ASIGMA**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **ASIGMA** is the in-house messaging application released by the Indian Army for the military sector.
 
• The app stands for **Army Secure IndiGeneous Messaging Application (ASIGMA)**, designed to provide a secure communication platform within the army.
 
• This app replaces other commercial messaging applications to ensure enhanced security and confidentiality of military communications.
 
• ASIGMA is developed as part of the Army's ongoing efforts to modernize communication systems and enhance operational efficiency.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The Indian Army has been focusing on indigenization and self-reliance in its technology and communication systems.
 
• ASIGMA is part of the broader initiative to reduce dependency on foreign applications and improve the security of sensitive communications.
 
• The app is expected to be regularly updated with new features and security enhancements to keep pace with evolving threats.
 
• In addition to ASIGMA, the Indian Army has been working on other indigenous projects to enhance its technological capabilities and operational readiness.
